reflections.summary: Won the decider by executing the pre-planned Metagross+Mamoswine core: Meteor Mash KO'd Garganacl through Wide Guard (single-target ignores it), Mamoswine's spread EQ KO'd Goodra through Follow Me, and the rehearsed Ice Shard+Meteor Mash double-target finished Clefable from 53% through Babiri exactly as calc'd. Opponent left Charizard/Venusaur home, so no sun to answer; Incineroar traded for Dragapult early (Lariat KO) and Aerodactyl's sack was absorbed. Only blemish: turn 3 both attackers fired
reflections.adjustment: When opponent shows Goodra+Garganacl, assume Goodra Protects under double pressure and punish the partner instead — Mash into Garganacl (sure KO) rather than doubling into Goodra's Protect, and never leave Incineroar in Body Press range (Parting Shot out). Also stop relying on consecutive Metagross Protects beside EQ-ing Mamoswine; on the second EQ turn, switch Aerodactyl into Meta's slot to absorb the spread instead of gambling on 1/3 Protect.

reflections.summary: Bringing a slow defensive core (Goodra-Hisui, Clefable, Garganacl) into Mega Metagross and Life Orb Mamoswine left the team with insufficient offensive output and vulnerable to heavy super-effective physical Steel and Ground hits.
reflections.adjustment: Against heavy physical Steel/Ground leads, avoid passive defensively-oriented picks and instead bring aggressive damage dealers with immediate Speed control or Burn pressure to prevent Metagross and Mamoswine from dictating tempo.
